notes.subject: wasiya
notes.rationale: נחלה (jatemali min bɛ taama) bɛ bayɛlɛma ni wasiya ye (diinɛ daɲɛ); 'jirisun' tun bɛ se ka kɛ a yɛrɛ ye

notes.subject: nka olu
notes.rationale: והם ye 'olu' ye kojugu (sinsinni); 'nka' farala a kan sabu kumasen in tugu Moshe ka somɔgɔli kɔ

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: kumasen in bɛ Yawe wele datugulen na, Moshe ka balo-ko kɔnɔ

notes.subject: bolo min nana jira
notes.rationale: 'זרוע הנטויה' (bolo min bɛ jira) ye Heburu ka laasubili ye min bɔna fanga bolo, a tɛ bolo yɛrɛ dɔrɔn

translation: Nka olu ye i ka jama ye, ani i ka wasiya, minnu n'u bɔra ni i ka se ba ye, ani ni i ka bolo min nana jira ye.

tokens.gloss: ani ni i ka bolo ye
